metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Wait, you meant to do that?’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I just got a kill by accident?
Enemy must’ve been sleepwalking.
Click if your aim’s a mystery but kills still happen.
Valorant logic is wild today.

Tap if you’ve ever won by pure accident!
